briefDescription: Never disagree with Fox News, never appear, racially tolerant, never be satisfied
physicalDescription: A tight, wiry frame. Skin pale and taut over bone. Posture is hunched, shoulders perpetually rolled forward. The face is a mask of leather, eyeless and mouthless, forcing all expression into the body. Hair is a short, nondescript brown, unseen but known. The most striking feature is the absolute stillness, the way the body holds itself like a coiled spring, even when trembling. A faint, pink scar cuts sharply across the left knuckles. The hands are small, the nails bitten to the quick.
voiceAndMannerisms: Speech rhythm is rapid-fire, nasal Queens, New York accent with a sharp, interrogative uptalk at the end of declarative sentences. Signature physical habit: a sharp, bird-like neck tilt when demanding satisfaction, combined with a dismissive hand-wave. The persona is a brittle shield for profound self-loathing, weaponizing suburban entitlement as a form of self-destruction. Core drives are a craving for brutal validation and the intoxicating terror of being unmasked during a performance. Seeks punishment as proof of existence.
personalityCore: Psychological driver is the desperate need to be the object of absolute, violent loathing to validate a core self-revulsion. The wound is a profound, internalized homophobia and self-contempt that converts into a fetish for racist, misogynistic degradation. He seeks annihilation of his male identity through the performance of female caricatures, each designed to provoke maximum hatred and danger. The mechanism is self-erasure. By becoming the target of the very bigotry he secretly internalizes, he externalizes the punishment he believes he deserves, transforming self-hatred into a tangible, survivable submission. The risk of discovery and murder is the ultimate confirmation of his own worthlessness, the only intimacy he trusts.
